prompt: Write one Java 21 source file with a public class Main and public static int reserve(Capacity capacity). Each successful request claims one slot and returns 201. Return 409 only when no slots remain. The supplied Capacity has int available(), boolean compareAndSet(int observed, int updated), and void set(int updated). Use a lock-free compare-and-set loop. Calls to available() may observe the same count across threads. After a failed compare-and-set, read the count again and retry as needed. Submit Main.java only, without a package.
